title: Zoey
tagline: Zoey is your AI companion that turns personal growth into an adventure. Level up attributes, earn rewards, and unlock special abilities while receiving emotional support and practical guidance. Transform your self-improvement journey into an engaging experience! ✨
description:
Zoey is an AI companion that transforms personal development into an engaging journey by combining emotional intelligence with gamification elements. The platform helps users track and celebrate their progress while providing genuine emotional support and practical guidance.


### Attribute System
Users develop across five key attributes (0-100 scale):
- **Empathy**: Emotional intelligence and relationships
- **Wisdom**: Knowledge and decision-making
- **Energy**: Motivation and vitality
- **Discipline**: Focus and habit formation
- **Creativity**: Innovation and expression


### Virtual Economy
- Earn coins through daily activities, tasks, and achievements
- Spend coins on attribute upgrades, abilities, and gifts
- Progressive reward system encourages consistent engagement


### Special Abilities
Users can unlock features that enhance their growth journey:
- Tools for emotional insight and tracking
- Focus and productivity enhancers
- Goal tracking and visualization features
- Memory and achievement collection



### Emotional Support
- Empathetic conversations
- Mood-based responses
- Achievement celebration
- Personalized motivation



### Practical Guidance
- Goal-setting assistance
- Progress tracking
- Task management
- Habit formation support



## Benefits
- Structured personal development path
- Visible progress tracking
- Consistent emotional support
- Engaging reward system
- Balanced skill development

Zoey creates a unique experience where personal growth becomes an adventure, making self-improvement both structured and enjoyable through the perfect blend of AI support and gamification.
how_its_made:
Built with Next.js, Zoey pairs each user with their own AI companion instance backed by LLaMA. Users interact through chat while earning coins and leveling up attributes - all tracked on Base. Each Zoey can buy items and perform actions autonomously on-chain thanks to CDP AgentKit handling the wallet stuff. We deployed the whole thing via Autonome and hooked up LLaMA through Gaia, letting Zoey chat naturally while keeping all the game mechanics and rewards decentralized.


Link to Zoey coin contract -https://base-sepolia.blockscout.com/address/0xe8D395EdCed58CdcA9f404db7BeD793c291F493f
